'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Thomas Whaley LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Thomas Wh... (surname faint)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
